name: Caleido (Torre Caleido)

position.source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/762323937 (centroid of the outline of the whole complex; long axis of the podium at 11.6°)

rights.note: Fenwick Iribarren Architects with Serrano-Suñer Arquitectura, for Grupo Villar Mir and Megaworld; built by OHL from April 2017 on the foundations of the unfinished Centro Internacional de Convenciones, completed in 2020 and opened on 19 October 2021; occupied mainly by IE University.

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q22970105_torre_caleido.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. The whole inverted T from the OpenStreetMap parts: the 20 m podium, 69.6 × 256 m, with garden roofs and two sunken parts at 15 m, and the black tower across its middle, 69.4 × 16.9 × 181 m, ribbed by thin vertical fins about 1.15 m apart that rise 1.6 m above the roof as a serrated edge, with the two smooth glass blocks standing out 5 m on the broad faces. Main façade (+Z) = the south broad face, like the Torre Moeve next to it. Uncertain: the top of the blocks (OSM 150 m; about 132 m on photos, used here) and their bottom (OSM 40 m, hidden by trees on the photos); the podium façades (glass, white bands and brown cladding) and gardens are generalised. The IE logo is left out. Not modelled: the A-shaped steel props of the lobby, the pergolas and paths of the park round the podium.
